Large yellow painting by Russna Kaur crossed by winding pale paths edged in bright colours, with green tent shapes and a small pastel panel
Two visitors look at framed prints and a ceramic cup displayed on a white wall in front of tall windows in the Gallery lobby
A long rainbow-coloured triptych painting, a dark wall relief, a draped office chair sculpture and small standing figures on a low plinth
A patterned wall with a blue and yellow banner that reads “Dreamworld” and a street photograph, beside a folding screen hung with fringed portraits

An artwork by Lotus Kang featuring shiny metal cans filled with copper-coloured strands, standing among bundles of yellow and black netting on the floor
